bidirectional_flow_key: protocol plus canonicalized IP-port endpoint pair
direction_encoding: +1 in the direction of the first observed packet of the flow, -1 in the reverse direction
segment_identifier: frame number of the first packet in the idle-timeout-delimited segment
packet_size: observed Ethernet frame length from frame.len
raw_storage_policy: one selected ZIP member is temporarily materialized using the 7-Zip CLI, processed, then deleted
archive_extraction_reason: Python 3.12 zipfile cannot decompress the compression method used by the original ISCXVPN2016 archives
